text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City ran splendidly in the Nihon 
Derby and achieved a remarkable result!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deafening cheers envelop her as she 
becomes a Derby Umamusume. However, her 
joy would not last long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though praised for her running, she is 
always hounded by remarks on her 
appearance, such as being "beautiful." She 
wonders aloud if this perception can ever 
be changed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, there is still the Kikuka Sho. On 
the grand stage where the strongest 
Umamusume is said to triumph, she was 
determined to turn public perception on 
its head.
